title: Hardware twin
intro: Run this lesson on a real Arduino: your sketch switches the real pins, and the real board's buttons and knobs move the sim.

support.unsupportedTitle: This browser can't reach USB boards
support.unsupported: The twin talks to the board over Web Serial, which this browser doesn't offer. Open iynk in a recent Chrome, Edge or Opera on a computer to connect a board. Everything else in iynk works here.
support.insecure: Web Serial only works on https pages and on localhost. Open iynk over https to connect a board.

lab.unsupported: The twin mirrors Board lab lessons for the Arduino Uno R3, Nano and Uno R4. Open one of those lessons to drive a real board.

setup.title: Before you connect
setup.flash: Upload StandardFirmata: in the Arduino IDE choose File › Examples › Firmata › StandardFirmata, then Upload.
setup.monitor: Close the IDE's Serial Monitor. Only one program can hold the port.
setup.wiring: Demo wiring: an LED with a 220 Ω resistor on pin 13 (or watch the L LED), and a potentiometer on A0 (outer legs to 5V and GND, middle leg to A0).

connecting: Connecting. The board restarts and blinks its L LED, which takes about three seconds.

toggles.driveHint: The sketch's outputs switch the real pins.
toggles.senseHint: Real buttons and knobs move the lesson's inputs.

run.running: The sketch is running and the board follows it.
run.stopped: Run the sketch in the lab to drive the real board.

safety.title: Mind the current
safety.current: A pin gives {ma} mA at the very most. Always put a 220 Ω to 1 kΩ resistor in series with an LED, and never power a motor, servo or relay from a pin.
safety.inputs: Pins the lesson wires to a button or sensor are only ever read, never driven.

pins.title: Live pins
pins.caption: What the sketch does on each pin, and what the real board is doing
pins.empty: This lesson doesn't use any pins yet.

errors.title: Couldn't connect
errors.busy: The port is busy. Close the Arduino IDE's Serial Monitor, or another tab using the board, and connect again.
errors.no-firmata: The board didn't answer in Firmata. Upload StandardFirmata (File › Examples › Firmata › StandardFirmata) and connect again.
errors.disconnected: The board was unplugged. Plug it back in and connect again.
errors.failed: Couldn't open the serial port. Unplug the board, plug it back in and try again.
errors.denied: This page isn't allowed to use serial ports. Check the site's permissions in your browser.
